what: Nieman Lab reports that Anne Helen Petersen (184,000-subscriber Culture Study newsletter) appreciated that when Patreon readers have subscription issues, they can talk to an "actual support person — not a bot." Patreon showed her newsletter functionality Petersen described as rivaling or improving upon Substack's.
verbatim_snippet: "She appreciated that when readers have subscriptions issues, they can talk to an 'actual support person — not a bot.'"
notes: Same source as F-P01 and F-P02, different speaker. Passage from Google search index. Petersen's direct subscriber letter (published on her Substack) referenced not wanting to be on a platform that had been "enshittified" — that quote sourced via Adweek/Like & Subscribe, not directly from Nieman Lab article.
